newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH C.BANK SELLS PLN 824 MLN NBP-BILLS.
newsitem.headline: POLISH C.BANK SELLS PLN 824 MLN NBP-BILLS.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland sold 242 million zlotys of its 182-day NBP-bills and set the minimum price at 90.91, after Polish banks bid for 342 million zlotys of the bills, the central bank said.
It also sold 583 million zlotys of 273-day NBP-bills and set the minimum price at 86.89 after banks bid for 825 million.
The average yield on the shorter paper was 19.78 percent and 19.90 percent for the longer paper.
